question: Which event was hosted at Lord's Cricket Ground (LCG) at the 2012 Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Archery**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Archery:-**

 
 
• The event hosted at Lord's Cricket Ground during the 2012 Olympics was Archery.
 
• This was the first time that Archery was included as an Olympic event at LCG.
 
• LCG is primarily known for hosting cricket matches and is often referred to as the "Home of Cricket". 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cricket:-**

 
 
• It is a popular sport in England and Lord's Cricket Ground is one of the most iconic cricket stadiums in the world.
 
 
 
• **Boxing**:-
 
 
• It is a combat sport that involves two participants wearing gloves and throwing punches at each other.
 
 
 
• **Archery:-**
 
 
• It involves shooting arrows at a target from a set distance and is a sport that requires a lot of focus and precision.
 
 
 
• **Equestrian**:-
 
 
• These events at the Olympics include dressage, jumping, and eventing, and involve horse and rider combinations competing in various challenges.
